body.x: HANNOVER, Germany (AVING Special Report on 'CeBIT 2007') -- <Visual News> Sharp displayed all of its three 108-inch full HD LCD TVs during CeBIT 2007.

They were made in Sharp’s Kameyama factory in Japan and the company claims that they were designed to be commercialized, not just a show-off model. The 108-inch TV can be customized depending on specific needs in terms of HDD capacity, number of USB port, and etc. Several casinos were said to take interests in purchasing the model during CES 2007 when the 108-inch model was first unveiled in the trade show in Las Vegas, USA.
